title: skills-ride-the-chokepoint
intention: SKILL VOYAGES GET A WORKFLOW — the chokepoint learns class skill@v1. Today a skill node cannot journal a voyage: the emit chokepoint refuses skill-class crossings with 'no registered workflow for class skill' (found live at /sail's first real crossing, filed as sail ticket edge (d)). This stone registers the skill@v1 workflow (the stages a skill node's life actually has — drafted, proved-by-crossing, challenged — whatever constrain/decompose settle them to be) so skill nodes ride the same record of truth as code-seams: journaled crossings at the one door, state compiled from history, gates able to see them.
why: Skills are load-bearing devices (the whole liturgy lives in them) but their voyages are invisible to the record — a skill 'proves out' today only in prose. The sail charter's own proof section says PROVED-by-first-crossing with no journal to show it. Every rule the gates enforce assumes the crossing exists; a node class that cannot cross cannot be gated (Law 4 needs the door to exist before physics can stand at it). Found-in-the-world provenance: the chokepoint itself named this gap at /sail's first crossing.
traces_to: Law 5 — a skill's voyage and proofs should share its address like every component's; today its history has nowhere to append
Law 4 — the /challenge cadence and prove-by-crossing are prose until the class has journaled stages a gate can stand on
Law 3 — 'PROVED by the first real crossing' is currently narration; a journaled crossing is the measurement
Law 1 — one workflow registry, one door; skill nodes compose the existing chokepoint, never a parallel journal

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: teeth beside the code — a skill-class node journals a full voyage through the chokepoint (the exact stage names per the settled workflow); the refusal that seeded this stone no longer fires for class skill; unknown classes still refuse loudly; existing code-seam crossings untouched (every test_transitions tooth still greens). Tester netns seal. Live gate: one real skill node (sail or chart) journals its first real crossing.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: the chokepoint still refusing class skill after the stone lands; a skill voyage journaled outside the one door (a parallel journal is the defect, not a workaround); an unknown node class now passing (the fix must not widen the door); a registered workflow whose stages nobody charted (stages invented in code rather than settled through the chain).
falsifier.horizon: re-read when a third node class wants registration (the second instance proves the registration pattern, the third earns a shared shape); when the concept-piece class (quorum-signature gates, /sorted's human-proved path) wants its workflow; when skill state/history berthing (class-space vs instance-space) is settled by the chain.

chart_notes.constrain: what the skill@v1 stages ARE (the workflow string) and where a skill node's state/history berth — skills live in class-space (repo skills/) so the record must too, but which address gates writes; also whether /challenge is a stage or a back-edge
chart_notes.survey: what CairnCommons/node_classes/ already charters for class skill; what the workflow registry's shape demands of a new class; which skill nodes exist today and what their first crossing would honestly journal
